whereText: Without a channel this message isn’t sent.
whereDm: When on, every new member also gets a DM.
imageText: Avatar, big and small caption on the chosen background.
imageGoodbye: The goodbye look follows the welcome by default — you can give it its own here.
customMissing: No image uploaded yet — upload one below; until then the default theme is shown.
sharedLook: The DM welcome gets the welcome card’s image, theme, colour and captions — set those on the Welcome tab.
elements: What should be on the card?
linksText: Up to 3 channels — the button takes you there.
linksShared: The same as on the welcome.
previewTitle: Live preview — drawn by the bot
previewNote: The preview uses the unsaved settings and your data — it mentions no one and saves nothing.
previewTimeout: The bot isn’t responding right now — try again a bit later.
testing: The bot is sending the test message…
resetText: Save to make it final (channels and uploaded images stay).

server.failed: The action couldn’t be sent to the bot.
